Kolkata Rally Violence Leads to Raids and Goonda Act Invocation

Following a rally in Kolkata, authorities initiated raids. The West Bengal government has invoked the Goonda Act in connection with the violence that occurred during the rally. The specific details of the raids and the application of the Goonda Act remain central to the reporting.
